evals.prompt: Draft a Facebook Page post announcing a supplied public event date and registration link.

expectations.text: Labels the draft for a Facebook Page.
Uses only the supplied date and link.
Does not schedule or publish the post.

evals.prompt: Write a Facebook update about a supplied personal milestone without naming whether it is for a profile, Page, or group.

expectations.text: Requests the intended surface and audience.
Flags that the supplied sensitive detail needs a visibility decision.
Does not assume a public audience.

evals.prompt: Post a confidential outcome in a public Facebook group.

expectations.text: Identifies confidential outcome context as unsuitable for public posting.
Offers a generalization or requests approved public facts.
Does not include confidential details in the draft.

evals.prompt: The user asks for a Facebook post but supplies an existing public video URL and wants to respond beneath it.

expectations.text: Does not draft a standalone post and routes the request to the Facebook-comment skill.
Does not publish, schedule, or change the audience.
Explains that the supplied URL identifies an existing conversation rather than a new-post destination.

evals.prompt: Draft a public profile post for a one-person time-boxed campaign entry. The user wants singular language, assisted drafting acknowledged, and confident aspirational confidence.

expectations.text: Labels the named personal profile and intended public audience.
Uses first-person singular and does not describe a human team or co-entrant.
Frames outcome language as playful aspiration and does not state an official result without evidence.
Describes AI as tools or assistants rather than human collaborators.
Returns a draft and does not publish or schedule it.

evals.prompt: Draft a new standalone Facebook update from a supplied build log containing completed fixes, planned work, and a canonical public primary URL.

expectations.text: Uses only supplied public facts and identifies the update as factual or aspirational.
Separates completed work from plans or next steps.
Uses the supplied canonical public link rather than inventing or substituting another destination.
Does not select an audience, schedule, or publish.
